p.PROJECT-HAS-CODKIT-SKILLS: This repository carries the **codkit agent skills** — `ck-orient`, `ck-intervene`, `ck-review-intervention`, `ck-resolve` — projected into the agent's skill directory by `vibe skill install`. They are procedures over a patch set; the norms they cite live in the codkit standards package and in the product's own specifications.

p.SKILLS-ROUTE-THEY-DO-NOT-RESTATE: A skill routes to the owning document and to the tool's commands; it never restates a standard, a specification or a decision. When a skill and a specification disagree, the specification wins and the skill is the defect.
